# Perspective vs Geometry and the 128D Research Model

Chimera II OS treats geometry and perspective as separate computational layers. Geometry describes mathematical structure; perspective describes how an observer/reference frame projects or interprets that structure.

The implementation covers vector norms, inner products, affine transforms, tensor contractions and observer projections, plus quantum-state normalization and Born probabilities.

The 128D model is a research representation, not a claim that physical spacetime has 128 observable dimensions.
